description: Developer QA harness for HackHub 1.3.0 / Content SDK 0.24.0 fences: quest completion, phone onEnd completion, Wi-Fi, HTTP/curl, collaborators, interception, Scheduler, pending-timer readback, on-demand quest launching, the P-01 backdated-tweet probe, the Twotter audit that flags the r31 poison shape, the two quests that share one account, the r199 pack-extras probe (menu item, desktop widget, right-click items, localization) r204's `qe24 extras say notify|toast` and r205's `qe24 clickprobe on|report|off` (which channels a start-menu click still has, now that UI calls from one are refused for lack of a mod identity) - one look per call, to find out which of the two UI APIs actually draws anything in 1.3.1. r209 adds the `qe24 mail` group (send/audit/remove/watch/cleanup/unload/bounce) and the QESdk024MailQa quest, probing SDK 0.24's Mail.remove, MailDefinition.replyable on both send paths, the raw Mail.Sent reply payload (repliedTo?), quest-end and unload cleanup, and Mail.sendBounce - rows M-01..M-10 in STATUS.md. r210: the mail rows ran (M-01..M-10 answered in STATUS.md); the pack-extras and click probes are retired and `qe24 extras cleanup` removes every QE24 menu/widget/right-click registration an older build left on the save.
